damast.packages.inherit: Inherit access from the linked repository
damast.packages.inherit_help: People and Actions workflows with read access to the linked repository can download this package; with write access they can publish new versions.
damast.stack.rebase_help: Rebases every layer onto the layer below it, and the bottom layer onto %s. Stops at the first conflict.
damast.stack.merge_desc: Merges %[1]s into %[2]s one after another (%[3]s). Every layer has to pass its own checks, reviews and branch protection; the run stops at the first layer that cannot be merged, and the layers above it stay open.
damast.stack.nothing_to_do: The stack is already up to date.
damast.stack.reason_rebase_conflict: rebasing commit %s caused a conflict. Rebase this layer locally, push it, then rebase the stack again.
damast.stack.reason_moved: the pull request changed since the page was loaded. Reload and try again.
damast.stack.reason_internal: an internal error occurred. The server log has the details.
